name: shahdara-team

source: Original copy of sidecars\shahdara-team\sidecar.json + shahdara-project\TEAM.md, TEAM_PROMPT.txt, team-gate.ps1, AGENTS.md, agentN\TASK.md from John's PC (2026-10-15). Not reconstructed.

Turn order is stored in shahdara-project\NEXT_AGENT.txt (agent1/agent2/agent3); per-turn log in TEAM_STATE.md.
